en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

No way! I can't believe you're such
a dirty pervert, Shuichi!

Whenever I read manga with music as part of
the main plot, I cry a lot since I can relate...

I know it's just fiction, but I feel like
it's really happening...

How do I explain it?
It motivates me to work harder.

Really? It's not like we have to read a book
with big words or anything...
Are you not in the mood to hang out with me?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
